name: GLEIF Company LEI Lookup
title: Company Lookup by Name or LEI: Entity, Address, Parent (GLEIF)
uses: CRM and lead enrichment with verified legal names, addresses and parents
AI agents that must confirm a company exists and who owns it

inputs.name: companyNames
inputs.title: Company names
inputs.description: Legal names to look up, e.g. ["Apple Inc.","Siemens AG"]. Exact legal name match first, then fuzzy full-text.

inputs.name: registrationNumbers
inputs.title: Registration numbers
inputs.description: Optional company-registry numbers as reported to GLEIF (registeredAs), e.g. a UK Companies House number.

inputs.name: country
inputs.title: Country
inputs.description: Optional ISO 2-letter country of the legal address, e.g. US, GB, DE. Improves name matching.

inputs.name: activeOnly
inputs.title: Active entities only
inputs.description: true (default) = skip lapsed/inactive entities for name and registration searches.

inputs.name: maxMatchesPerName
inputs.title: Max matches per name
inputs.description: How many candidate entities to return per name or registration number (1-50).

inputs.name: includeParents
inputs.title: Include parent companies
inputs.description: true (default) = add direct and ultimate parent (LEI, name, country) where reported.

inputs.name: maxResults
inputs.title: Max results
inputs.description: Maximum rows overall (1-5000). You pay per row: 100 rows = $0.30.

description: Verify companies worldwide from the official GLEIF LEI API: legal name, status, jurisdiction, registration number, legal and HQ address, direct and ultimate parent. KYB and enrichment for 2.9M+ entities.

inputSchema.title: Company Lookup by Name or LEI: Legal Entity, Address, Parent (GLEIF)
inputSchema.description: Looks up legal entities worldwide in the official GLEIF Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) database and returns one JSON row per matched company with legal name, status, address, registration number and parent companies. Example: {"companyNames":["Apple Inc."],"country":"US"} or {"leis":["HWUPKR0MPOU8FGXBT394"]}. Pricing: $0.003 per company row.
